'''''Shark Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of 4 [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] that were one of two groups of fighters in the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Ardent (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Ardent'']]. The squadron was destroyed by [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] that engaged the cruiser. The cruiser was badly damaged but managed to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
